name: Arrange Footprints in Circle
description: Place selected footprints evenly on a circle with live preview. No duplication, schematic links stay intact.
description_full:
Moves the SELECTED footprints onto a circle (center = centroid of the selection). Nothing is duplicated, so every footprint keeps its schematic link (no "Update PCB from Schematic" conflicts).

Ideal for rings of serially-chained RGB LEDs or other circular part layouts.

Features:
- Live preview: each footprint is drawn as its pad bounding box, rotated according to the current settings
- Radius and start angle (0 deg = east, -90 deg = north/12 o'clock)
- Clockwise or counter-clockwise order (placement order = ascending reference)
- "Rotate parts": point each part's 0 deg direction radially outward
- "Keep silkscreen text upright": rotate parts but counter-rotate text on silkscreen layers so it stays readable (0/180 deg rule)
- Normal edit operation, undoable with Ctrl+Z

Usage: select the footprints in the PCB editor, then run Tools -> External Plugins -> Arrange Footprints in Circle.
